description: Eight-step Markov gate sequencer: on every clock pulse the next step is drawn at random, weighted by the eight knobs belonging to the step it is on

params.text: Sets the weight of one move: each column of knobs belongs to the step the sequence is on and each knob in it to a step that might come next, so the higher it is the likelier that move

inputs.text: A rising edge moves the sequence straight to that step, whatever the knobs say
A rising edge draws the next step and moves to it; the gate outputs stay high while this input is high, and nothing runs with nothing patched here
A rising edge starts the sequencer again after it has stopped

outputs.text: Carries a 10V gate while the sequence is on that step and the clock input is high

notes: when the eight knobs of the current step add up to less than 1, the remainder is the chance that the sequencer stops on the next clock pulse
The sequencer has no clock of its own: it stays where it is and no gate fires until a clock reaches the clock input.
